uk.title: Employee privacy notice — {{companyName}} (United Kingdom)
uk.body:
# Employee privacy notice — {{companyName}} (United Kingdom)

> **DRAFT — for legal review.** Template version 2026-10-18, prepared from the information UK GDPR Articles 13 and 14 require (https://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2016/679/article/13). {{companyName}} is the controller and must check and complete every section before publishing it. Thapsus-HR provides this template and is not your lawyer.

## Who we are

{{companyName}}, {{companyAddress}}, is the controller of the personal data described in this notice. Contact us about your data at {{privacyContactEmail}}. Our data protection officer, if we have appointed one: {{dpoContact}}

## What we collect

- Identity and contact details: name, preferred name, pronouns, date of birth, home address, personal email and phone, emergency contacts.
- Employment details: job title, department, location, manager, contract, start and end dates, working pattern, performance and training records.
- Pay details: salary, pay changes and the information our payroll provider needs.
- Time off, absence and sickness, including fit notes and return-to-work records.
- Working time: rotas, clock-in and clock-out times and, only at sites where we have told you location checks apply, your location when you clock in.
- Right-to-work checks and copies of documents.
- Equality and diversity information, only if you choose to give it.
- Records of your use of our HR system for security (sign-in times, IP address, device).

## Why we use it and our lawful basis

| Purpose | Lawful basis | Condition for special category data |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Managing your employment contract, pay and benefits | Contract (Art. 6(1)(b)) | — |
| Meeting legal duties such as right-to-work checks, working-time records, tax and statutory pay | Legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c)) | Employment law (Art. 9(2)(b)) for health data |
| Managing absence and making adjustments | Legal obligation / legitimate interests | Employment law (Art. 9(2)(b)) |
| Equality monitoring | `[legitimate interests or consent — legal to decide]` | `[condition to be confirmed]` |
| Security of our systems | Legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(f)) | — |

`[Replace or extend this table with your own purposes and bases.]`

## Who we share it with

- Thapsus-HR, which hosts our HR system as our processor in the United Kingdom (London). Its sub-processors are listed at {{subprocessorListUrl}}.
- Our payroll provider, pension provider and IT providers, where we have connected them.
- HMRC and other authorities when the law requires it.

We do not transfer your data outside the UK through our HR system. `[Add any transfers you make yourselves and the safeguard used.]`

## How long we keep it

We keep each type of record for the period in our retention schedule: {{retentionSchedule}}. Some periods are set by law (for example working-time records are kept for two years from the date they were made under the Working Time Regulations 1998, regulation 9).

## Your rights

You can ask us for a copy of your data, to correct it, to delete it, to restrict or object to our use of it, and to move it to another organisation. We will respond within one month, which we may extend by two further months for complex or numerous requests; we will tell you if we do. Contact {{privacyContactEmail}}.

You can complain to us (UK GDPR Article 12(4) and section 164A of the Data Protection Act 2018) and to the Information Commission (formerly the Information Commissioner's Office), which regulates data protection in the UK.

## Changes to this notice

We will tell you about important changes. Last updated: {{publishedDate}}.

# Workforce privacy notice — {{companyName}} (United States, including California)

> **DRAFT — for legal review.** Template version 2026-10-18, prepared from the California Consumer Privacy Act as published by the California Privacy Protection Agency (https://cppa.ca.gov/regulations/pdf/ccpa_statute.pdf). {{companyName}} is the business responsible for this notice and must check and complete every section before publishing it, including any other state's requirements. Thapsus-HR provides this template and is not your lawyer.

## Who we are

{{companyName}}, {{companyAddress}}. Contact us about your information at {{privacyContactEmail}} or {{privacyContactPhone}}.

## Information we collect about job applicants, employees and contractors

| Category | Examples | Why we use it | How long we keep it |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Identifiers | Name, address, email, phone, employee number | Employment administration | {{retentionIdentifiers}} |
| Employment information | Job, manager, location, contract, performance | Managing your employment | {{retentionEmployment}} |
| Compensation | Pay rate, pay changes, payroll information | Paying you; tax and wage-and-hour compliance | {{retentionPayroll}} |
| Time and attendance | Schedules, clock-in/out times, time off | Scheduling, overtime and leave law compliance | {{retentionTime}} |
| Sensitive personal information | Government ID for Form I-9, health information for leave, voluntary race/ethnicity and sex for EEO reporting | Legal compliance only | {{retentionSensitive}} |
| Internet or system activity | Sign-in times, IP address, device | Security of our systems | {{retentionSecurity}} |

We do not sell your personal information or share it for cross-context behavioral advertising. `[Confirm.]` We use sensitive personal information only for the purposes listed above. `[Legal to confirm whether the right to limit applies.]`

## Who receives it

- Thapsus-HR, our HR system provider, acting as our service provider and storing data in the United States (Ohio, with backup copies in N. California). Its sub-processors are listed at {{subprocessorListUrl}}.
- Payroll, benefits and IT providers we connect, and government agencies where the law requires.

## Your rights (California residents)

You can ask us to tell you what personal information we hold and how we use it, to give you a copy, to correct it, and to delete it, subject to legal exceptions. We will not retaliate against you for using these rights.

To make a request, contact {{privacyContactEmail}} or call {{privacyContactPhone}}. We will verify your request and respond within 45 days of receiving it; if we need more time we will tell you within those 45 days and may take up to 45 more days (California Civil Code §1798.130(a)(2)).

You can use an authorized agent; we may ask for proof of their authority.
